name: R10-BF11-FLOOR-RHU-W0
decode: sRGB byte -> linear (piecewise IEC) -> half, round to nearest even

stage.inputs: two half values A (weight 64-k) and B (weight k), k in 0..63, weights k/64 exact
stage.align: e = max(frexp exponent of A, of B); grid g = 2^(e-11); A' = floor(A/g)*g, B' = floor(B/g)*g
stage.output: round to half, nearest, ties up (away from zero, values >= 0)

weights_for_unseen_jobs: k = floor(64 * f) (exact when f is on the 1/64 grid)

two_stage_combinations_declared_before_s.XY: stage on x (corners 00,10 and 01,11, weight ix) -> two halves -> stage on y (weight iy); the first-stage outputs are halves, no further decode
two_stage_combinations_declared_before_s.YX: stage on y (00,01 and 10,11, weight iy) -> two halves -> stage on x (weight ix)
two_stage_combinations_declared_before_s.headline: XY (E720 two-stage form, x first); YX scored as the declared alternative
